newsitem.title: USA: Sepragen receives orders for new system.
newsitem.headline: Sepragen receives orders for new system.

text.p: Sepragen Corp said Monday it received orders from Glaxo Wellcome and Neose Corp for its new QuantaSep Process LC System, an automated process workstation.

Sepragen said in a release that the system, which reduces the level of operator skills and labor costs associated with large scale liquid chromatography systems, is controlled by the company's recently released software Version 2.0.
The company said this software "brings an unparalleled degree of reliability and speed in scaling up the process from laboratory to full-scale manufacturing."
Sepragen also said the orders from the two biopharmaceutical firms add to its "growing list" of companies using Sepragen technology in the manufacture of genetically engineered drugs.
For the month of November, Sepragen said it received over $300,000 in orders.
